title: feat(pm): dispatch-gates derives the ui/scripts/__tests__ suite for diffs under ui source, ui apps, skills/objectui and ui/scripts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DF9skmntVkpgbtnjpLwPvPW)_

## What

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` now derives `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (the whole `ui/scripts/__tests__` suite) for any diff touching one of the card's four roots: `ui/packages/**/src`, `ui/apps/**`, `skills/objectui/**` or `ui/scripts/**`. Before this, those 180 files (178 that run, 2 skipped) ran only in CI's 16 `Test UI` shards and no derived family named them.

## How (the tool's own convention, no parallel mechanism)

- **A change-kind row.** A new row in `CHANGE_KIND_ROWS` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`) with predicate `ui-scripts-suite-input`, bound in `CHANGE_KIND_PREDICATES`. The roots are data (`UI_SCRIPTS_SUITE_ROOTS`). They are matched in CI's own `paths:` language through the existing `triggerListCovers`, so a directory surface counts the way it counts for a workflow trigger.
- **Bound to the CI job it stands in for.** Every other gate in that table resolves by name against a discovered `check:*` family. This suite has no such family: the only step that runs it is `Test UI`'s vitest line, which carries a shard and the affected-test selector's filter list, and `.github/**` is out of scope here. So the gate declares `ciJob: 'Test UI'` and `ciRunner: 'pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run'`.
  - `ciJobRunsRunner` resolves the gate against the same `workflowEntries` the discovery reads. If the job is renamed or the runner is respelled, the gate renders STALE, which is the same rot report a renamed family gets.
  - `bindChangeKindRows` refuses a half-declared binding at load.
  - The census guard in the self-test reds when the live workflows stop running it.
- **It reaches every output.** Through `kindGroups` the gate is in `--commands`, `--json`, the human convention block, the `--residue` kind list and `--ran` (`commandsFor` → `runReconciliation`). Nothing moves in the family partition: the residue still places 326 of 326.
- **The `why` names its prerequisite.** The suite needs the seven `@objectstack` packages `Test UI` builds first. Unbuilt, 16 files go red on a missing dist import (measured below). So the line prints the job's own turbo build command.

## Measured first

All measured on a 4-vCPU cloud container at base `6390fe52`.

| Reading | Result |
|---|---|
| Suite, packages unbuilt | 16 files failed / 162 passed, 231 s (missing `@objectstack/spec` dist and similar) |
| Seven packages built (job's turbo command) | 274 s cold |
| Suite, built — run 1 | **178 passed, 2 skipped, 284 s** |
| Suite, built — run 2 | **178 passed, 2 skipped, 286 s** |

Vitest reports ~270 s of the run as module import.

Reach of the 180 files, from a static scan of each file plus the helpers it imports relatively. This is a source scan, not a runtime trace.

| Root | Files that read it (file + helpers) | File alone |
|---|---|---|
| `ui/packages/**/src` | 165 | 128 |
| `ui/apps/**` | 141 | 66 |
| `skills/objectui/**` | 16 | 8 |
| `ui/scripts/**` | 170 | 140 |

**Decision: the whole suite, not an affected subset.** On this container it is about five minutes, not the card's "about a minute". It still replaces a ~25-minute CI round trip. A subset map would have to model what each file reads off the tree: 165 of the 180 read package source and 141 the apps. That map is exactly the second list that goes stale, and it would save minutes, not a round trip. The deletion criterion and the stated blind spot sit with the row's docblock.

## Self-test pins (fast tier, in-process)

- A diff under each of the four roots derives the suite, both in the rendered convention block (anchored on the delimiter) and in the runnable union.
- `packages/core/src/x.ts`, `ui/packages/core/package.json`, `skills/objectstack/SKILL.md` and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derive neither.
- A run record that carries every derived command except the suite is not ok, and names the suite unrun. The control with it is ok.
- An unresolved binding renders STALE, naming the job and the runner.
- `ciJobRunsRunner` resolves on a fixture job, fails on a renamed job and on a respelled runner, and resolves against the live workflows.
- A half-declared binding refuses at load.
- One existing pin moved. The `inherited-population` marker line census reads `dispatch-gates.mjs:738` instead of `:736`, because the data import and its re-export each gained one name. It carries a comment like its neighbours.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test --fast`, detached: **1935 cases pass**. The full battery result is in the gate run below.

## End to end on PR #26274 head 1ef5c482

The head is reachable. Merge base `2409c9c8`, 57 changed files.
- `--commands` over those 57 files: 66 commands. Against the base tool (same tree, `6390fe52`) the only difference is the added line `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`.
- I ran that command in a worktree at `1ef5c482`, after the seven-package build: **4 files failed, 174 passed**. It reproduces all three reds the card measured:
  - `check-skill-examples.test.ts`: `json: 69 marked, floor 70` (the MARKED_FLOOR).
  - `turbo-build-inputs.test.ts`: `@object-ui/console`'s build reads `packages/sdui-parser/src/retired-visibility-dialects.ts`, which turbo's build inputs do not declare.
  - `check-doc-expression-carriage.test.ts`: 10 failures on the carriage fixtures.
  - The fourth, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.test.ts › exits 0 as a process`, was a 15 s timeout while the dispatch-gates self-test ran on the same 4 cores. It passed in both clean runs on main. I read it as container load, not that head's.

## No narrowing

`--commands` from this branch vs main's tool on the same tree, sorted and diffed:

| Paths | main | this branch | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/core/src/index.ts` | 49 | 49 | none |
| `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` | 30 | 30 | none |
| `ui/scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` | 12 | 13 | + the suite |
| `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` | 34 | 35 | + the suite |
| `ui/apps/console/package.json` + a spec file | 85 | 86 | + the suite |
| #26274's 57 files | 65 | 66 | + the suite |

No line was removed in any set.

## Local gates for this diff

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths, from git, merge base `6390fe52`) derives 30 families for this diff. All 30 ran, each recorded as `CMD :: exit N`, and **all 30 exited 0**. `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` is the fast tier, 1935 cases in 377 s.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list` reports: `30 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`, exit 0.

The slow tier (`--self-test` without `--fast`) runs on `main`'s push and schedule only. Its local reading is reported on the card.

## Out of scope, noted for the seat

- `dispatch-gates.mjs`'s `pnpm` recognizer reads `pnpm [--filter X] [run] check:*`, never `pnpm --dir ui run check:*`. So the 38 distinct `check:*` scripts that `Lint UI` / `Build & E2E UI` invoke that way in `ci.yml` are discovered as no family at all.
- Those jobs' `if:` is `ui_tree != 'false' && ui != 'false'`, which `jobIfReading` refuses as an intersection. So they appear in neither the job-filtered tail nor the always-runs tail.
- That is a reproducible under-derivation for every ui card, and it is not fixed here. It needs its own card (recognizer + `&&`-of-filter-outputs reading).

## Governance

- Changed paths: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`.
- No `.github/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/**` or `skills/**` file is touched, and no governed text quotes the change-kind list.
- `check-governed-merges --test` on these paths: 0 hits.
- The data module's header says "A new gate family under a kind is one row here, still only on the maintainer's words". This row comes from card #26318, which was dispatched under the maintainer's standing devx grant. Flagged so the seat can judge whether that suffices.
- Changeset: none. This is a private root script, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #26318
